extractor_notes.blockers: Profusa is a commercial-stage digital health / biosensor company (Lumee oxygen tissue monitoring platform). Recent 8-Ks cover a Mayo Clinic know-how collaboration for high-impact clinical applications, a non-binding LOI to acquire BioInsights PanOmics multi-omics diagnostic platform for $30M, Nasdaq listing transfer to Capital Market, and corporate governance items. No clinical/regulatory catalysts such as PDUFA/BLA/NDA/IND/Phase trial readouts are disclosed.
